name: Edoardo Mazzilli
headline: Sr. Director @ Journey Capital | Sales, Partnerships, Account Management
about:
I have had the pleasure of working in both the financial and media world. I have worked for large corporations and have acquired experience in diverse fields. I have touched upon numerous aspects of Business Development, namely:
Channel Partnerships, Sales, Customer Service, Operations and Administration to name a few.

I have held numerous upper management positions, am a solution oriented team player & a leader who thrives to succeed in a stimulating work environment.

 My current responsibilities include; overseeing the Account Management team, Relationship Management team, Partnership Channels. I work well under pressure. 

One of my greatest accomplishments is building & maintaining solid relationships with all business partners, regardless of the size of the company. 
We, as a team, are responsible for 75% of the company's total sales volume. 

Goals:
Building strategic partnerships 
Increase the company's productivity
Continuously develop new business
Provide excellent customer service 
Work well under pressure in a stimulating environment 
Lead a solid team

Major Achievements: Taking on new projects and building them up and taking them to another level of success is what I thrive for. Sales and Customer relations also ranks high on my list of things I take pride in. I have been recognized for my ability to problem solve. I work well under pressure and have become a pro at damage control when need be. I thrive while working in a team environment all while leading and strategizing innovated ways to increase the company's productivity and profit margins. Business Development and Operations are also two of my strong interests.
